exposure: Women who received blood transfusions vs. those who did not
cohort: 405 pregnant women with placenta previa who underwent Cesarean delivery, with 135 receiving blood transfusions and 270 serving as controls
finding: Previous Cesarean section, anterior placentation, major placenta previa, preoperative bleeding exceeding 250 mL, preoperative anemia, and emergency Cesarean section were independent risk factors for blood transfusion during Cesarean section in pregnancies complicated by placenta previa.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was identified as an independent factor that increased the risk of blood transfusion for women undergoing cesarean section due to placenta praevia.
gest_age: Mentioned as a factor, with cases more likely to deliver at <37 weeks
